name: HubSpot Call Urgency NLP Routing Engine

parameters.content:
## Call Urgency NLP Routing Engine
**Safe by default.** With no env vars set, a manual run scores SYNTHETIC transcripts, makes no AI calls, updates nothing in HubSpot and sends nothing to Slack. Webhook deliveries are ignored in sandbox and rejected without `INBOUND_WEBHOOK_SECRET`.

CRM updates need: `SANDBOX_MODE=false`, `DRY_RUN=false`, `HUBSPOT_MUTATIONS_ENABLED=true`, `HUBSPOT_ACCESS_TOKEN`.
AI needs: `AI_ANALYSIS_ENABLED=true` + `AI_API_KEY`.
Slack needs: `SEND_SLACK_ALERTS=true` + `DRY_RUN=false` + `SLACK_ALERT_WEBHOOK_URL`.

See README.md · DISCLAIMER.md
